title: Integrated Management of Pathogens and Microbes in Cannabis sativa L. (Cannabis) under Greenhouse Conditions
notes: Cannabis-specific greenhouse review supporting integrated disease-management principles, including pathogen-free stock, sanitation, irrigation/environment management, monitoring, resistant/tolerant genetics and jurisdictionally permitted biological or biorational tools. Accurate diagnosis and integrated prevention are emphasized. Product legality, label compliance and treatment authority require separate jurisdiction/facility verification.
